title: Behavior Random Breach
description: Allows the mob to randomly break surface of the water.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

cooldown_time.description: Time in seconds between breach attempts.

interval.description: Time in ticks between breach attempts.

xz_dist.description: Maximum horizontal distance in blocks of the breach destination.

y_dist.description: Maximum vertical distance in blocks of the breach destination.
